lines.text: He builds his house by unjust gain to escape disaster, but the stones will cry out from the wall.
Woe to him who builds a city with bloodshed; the earth will fill with the knowledge of the LORD's glory.
Idols have no breath, but the LORD is beside the city gate, and all the earth must be silent.
